svg.title: How a diagram reaches every reader
svg.desc: A diagram is a Mermaid source in docs/diagrams/. scripts/diagrams.sh draws it with mermaid-cli in Docker as an SVG picture for the light and one for the dark theme, which the Markdown shows with a picture element, so that the GitHub app, the stores, e-mails and github.com all show it. The website draws the source itself, live. In a pull request that changes a diagram, the check diagrams draws the pictures anew, and the diagram bot commits those that differ.
